description: Optional declarative local-first security and privacy review pack for threat modeling, secret scanning, permission review, MCP/browser risk, dependency review, and release signoff.

notes: This pack reviews grants and approvals but does not mutate or override them.
MCP and browser owner packs keep routing and execution control.
Network and executable scanning are intentionally out of scope.

base_pack_promotion.reason: Security review guidance should remain optional and must not become implicit grant or approval authority.

conflict_notes: This pack complements defaultspack permission and approval policy; it does not replace it.
This pack complements MCP gateway and browser packs by reviewing risk evidence; it does not route or execute those tools.
Use owner packs and runtime policy as the enforcement boundary.
security_notes: No secrets, executable scanner code, remote endpoints, or network connector configuration are embedded.
Network is none by default and review output is local metadata only.
